title: He Hijacked a Plane, Then Jumped Into the Night

lines.text: He opened the back door of a jetliner in flight. And jumped.
With two hundred thousand dollars in ransom.
November 24th, 1971. Northwest Orient Flight 305.
A passenger ticketed as Dan Cooper handed a flight attendant a note.
It claimed he had a bomb.
He wanted two hundred thousand dollars. And four parachutes.
In Seattle, he traded thirty-six passengers for the cash and chutes.
Then he sent the jet back up, south, toward Mexico.
Over southwest Washington, in a night storm, he lowered the rear stairs.
And stepped off into the dark.
Searchers combed the forest below. No trace of him was ever found.
Then, in 1980, an eight-year-old boy was smoothing sand for a campfire on the Columbia River.
Under the sand: three rotting bundles of twenty-dollar bills.
About five thousand eight hundred dollars. The serial numbers matched the ransom.
But that riverbank sits miles from where investigators believed he jumped.
Washed downstream? Buried? Nobody has proven how it got there.
The rest of the money has never been found.
Hijackings like his led the FAA to order a lock on the 727's rear stairs. It's called the Cooper vane.
In 2016, the FBI stopped actively investigating. Hundreds of suspects. No charges.
Did he die in those woods? Or walk out of them?
Where do you think he landed?
Because all anyone knows for sure is this.

shots.description: Frame 1 already moving: underside of the tail of the stylised 727 at night in heavy rain. Stylised Boeing 727 built from primitives: fuselage = cylinder (r 1.9 m, 40 m) with tapered cone nose and tail cone, dark navy-grey metal with a red cheat-line stripe (no airline logo), three rear engines = short cylinders clustered at the tail, T-tail = thin boxes on top of a swept fin, swept wings = flattened bevelled boxes. Ventral airstair = hinged box ramp (0.9 m wide, 6 m long, stepped bump-map) dropping from under the tail cone, open, with a warm cabin-light spill above it. A faceless suited silhouette stands on the lowest step of the open airstair, coat flapping, a small bag strapped to the chest; on 'jumped' he drops out of frame downward and the stairs bounce up.
shots.camera: low angle from behind/below the tail, 28mm, slow push-in from frame 1, handheld amp 0.03 (turbulence), slight roll
characters: hijacker silhouette (char_figure, coat=True, dark suit, faceless, no glasses detail)
shots.lighting: black-blue night; warm sodium cabin spill through the stair opening; lightning flash (flicker) on 'jumped'

shots.description: Close tracking shot of a canvas money bag (rounded box mesh, khaki cloth, drawstring) tumbling through rain and cloud, strapped to the dark silhouette's torso (only torso + arm visible, no face). A couple of $20-style green paper rectangles (plain, no real banknote artwork) flutter past camera.
shots.camera: tracking freefall, 35mm, camera rotates slowly around the bag; motion blur
shots.lighting: dark blue ambient, lightning rim light from above

shots.description: Map card: stylised Pacific Northwest coastline; a route line draws north from PORTLAND to SEATTLE; pin on Seattle. Date stamp types on.
shots.camera: 2D overlay over a darkened rain-on-window background plate (slow zoom)
shots.lighting: n/a (overlay); background plate dim blue-grey
fx: rain drops on glass in background plate

shots.description: Low-poly 727 cabin (corridor builder re-skinned: narrow aisle, rows of box seats in muted 1970s orange/brown, small round windows with rain). Rear-row faceless suited silhouette extends an arm; a folded paper note passes into the hand of a second silhouette in a flight attendant's uniform (char_figure, lighter colour). Focus pulls to the note.
shots.camera: aisle-level 50mm, slow dolly toward the rear row; rack focus to the note
shots.lighting: warm overhead cabin light, cool window light, soft

shots.description: Document reveal: a small torn note card slides up (paraphrase only, not the real wording). Behind it, the cabin plate blurs; a dark briefcase on the seat is lit by a single overhead spot.
shots.camera: 2D overlay over blurred cabin plate; slow push on the briefcase behind
shots.lighting: single top-light on the briefcase, rest dark

shots.description: Top-down on a dark table: four parachute packs (rounded boxes with harness straps, olive and white) slam down one after another in time with the words, next to a stack of banded green bill-bricks.
shots.camera: top-down 35mm, tiny push-in each time a pack lands
shots.lighting: hard top-light, red rim from below

shots.description: Rain-soaked airport apron at night (ground plane, wet roughness 0.1, yellow taxi line). The stylised 727 sits under floodlights, front door open; a line of small faceless silhouettes walks down a boarding stair away from the jet while a single figure carries a bag toward the tail.
shots.camera: wide 35mm from the apron, slow truck right, reflections in the puddles
shots.lighting: orange sodium floodlights, wet reflections, rain backlit

shots.description: Same map card style: route line now draws SOUTH from Seattle, past Portland, dashed toward the bottom edge with 'RENO (refuel) / MEXICO' label off-card. A small jet icon rides the line.
shots.camera: 2D overlay over dark cloud plate, slow drift down
shots.lighting: n/a

overlay.text:
HEADING SOUTH
toward Mexico, via Reno to refuel

shots.description: Side view of the stylised 727 flying through rain cloud; the ventral airstair under the tail slowly hinges down, spilling a wedge of warm light into the rain. Lightning backlights the cloud deck.
shots.camera: parallel tracking shot, 50mm, jet left-to-right, slow push toward the tail
shots.lighting: dark storm blue; lightning flicker every ~1.5 s; warm stair light

shots.description: Looking straight down: a tiny silhouette falls away from camera into black cloud; a parachute canopy (half-sphere mesh, pale fabric) blooms; through a cloud break, an endless dark forest (forest builder, dense conifers as cone stacks) far below.
shots.camera: top-down from the stair, 24mm, camera holds while figure shrinks; slow rotation
shots.lighting: almost black; faint moon/cloud glow; canopy lit by one lightning flash

shots.description: Daylight-grey overcast: low aerial over wet conifer forest and a river bend; three faceless searcher silhouettes in a line push through ferns with torches; nothing found.
shots.camera: low drone pass over the treetops, 35mm, then tilt down to the searchers
shots.lighting: flat overcast grey-green, torch cones in mist

shots.description: MID-POINT TURN — colour flips from storm blue to pale winter daylight. A wide sandy riverbank (ground plane with sand material + ripples) beside a broad grey river; a small child silhouette kneels, sweeping sand flat with his hands; a parent silhouette in the background stacks driftwood.
shots.camera: wide 35mm, slow push toward the kneeling child
shots.lighting: low cold winter sun, long shadows, soft haze over the water

shots.description: Macro: sand slides away to reveal three blackened, swollen bundles of green paper (stacked thin planes, edges frayed, darker at corners), held by perished rubber bands. Generic bills only — no real banknote design.
shots.camera: macro 85mm, top-down rack focus as sand pours off
shots.lighting: low raking winter sun, wet sand sparkle

shots.description: Evidence card: a recovered bill fragment on the left, a 1971 ransom-list microfilm strip on the right; serial-number rows highlight and a red line connects them, then a red MATCH stamp. Serial numbers are placeholders (e.g. L0000000A), not real ones.
shots.camera: 2D overlay, push-in on the matching rows
shots.lighting: n/a

overlay.text:
~$5,800 in $20 bills
Serials on the 1971 ransom list

shots.description: Map card: the estimated flight path is a thin dashed line north-south; a soft red oval marks the presumed drop zone; the route line draws from the drop zone to a pin on Tena Bar further south-west on the river, with a '~20 MI?' tag.
shots.camera: 2D overlay over dark river plate
shots.lighting: n/a

overlay.text:
DROP ZONE vs. TENA BAR
estimates vary

shots.description: Evidence board (dark cork wall): two theory cards pin on in time with the words; a third card reads '?'. Red string links them to a photo-style card of the sandbar (rendered, not a photo).
shots.camera: slow push-in, 35mm, slight handheld
shots.lighting: single desk lamp, warm, deep shadows

shots.description: Callback to S02: the empty sky over the dark forest at night, rain; no figure, no bag. A counter subtracts the find from the ransom.
shots.camera: slow tilt down from cloud to treetops, 35mm
shots.lighting: dark blue, faint moon

shots.description: Clean technical cutaway: the stylised 727 tail in a dim hangar; a small spring-loaded paddle (thin box on a hinge) under the fuselage flips into the airflow line, and the airstair attempts to drop but is blocked. Blueprint-blue line overlay draws the paddle.
shots.camera: side 50mm, slow orbit 20 deg around the tail
shots.lighting: cool hangar top-lights, blue blueprint lines

overlay.text:
Spring-loaded vane blocks the
rear stairs from opening in flight

shots.description: Document reveal: a neutral recreated case-file cover (no real FBI seal or letterhead) with 'NORJAK' typed; a rubber stamp slams 'ACTIVE INVESTIGATION ENDED - JULY 2016'.
shots.camera: 2D overlay over a dark desk plate, slight push
shots.lighting: n/a

overlay.text:
CASE: NORJAK (Northwest hijacking)
Suspects considered: 800+
Charged: none
Status: active investigation ended,
July 2016

shots.description: Dawn in the conifer forest, mist on the ground; a single pale parachute shape tangled high in a tree branch?  NO — keep it ambiguous: empty clearing, a faint line of footprints that fades out after a few metres.
shots.camera: slow ground-level push through the trees, 24mm
shots.lighting: blue-grey dawn, god rays through fog

overlay.text:
FBI view: he probably didn't survive
No body has ever been found

shots.description: Map card from S15 again, empty of pins; a pulsing '?' pin waits over the forest region.
shots.camera: 2D overlay, slow zoom
shots.lighting: n/a

shots.description: Loop frame: same framing as S01 — underside of the 727 tail in rain, airstair open, warm spill; the suited silhouette steps back onto the bottom stair, matching frame 1.
shots.camera: matches S01: low angle 28mm, push-in, handheld
shots.lighting: as S01

loop_line: Because all anyone knows for sure is this.
